title: Outstanding teacher....
text: Outstanding teacher. Really nice experience. Eugene was very patient, explained things clearly and is a very nice guy. My daughters and I were very happy with our art
author: Samir_A

title: Sketching the cathedral was awesome!
text: Instruction was easy to follow.  I learned many new things in sketching.  We sketched the cathedral.  At first I thought this is very detailed but the instructor simplified how to approach it.  I learned how to best use the pencil and how to use the board to guide my hand.  My final sketch came out amazing.  I thoroughly enjoyed my time!
author: Gina K

title: Church sketch
text: I was pleased with the final sketch thanks to excellent direction. Even the walk to the sketch location was pleasant and full of interesting history.
author: Elizabeth_S

title: Great class for showing anyone how to draw an urban scene as well as provide the opportunity to carefully observe
text: Great perspective tips and information on drawing convincing architecture and people in a city space.
author: Jay_N

title: Arc de Triompf Sketch
text: This was by far one of the best highlights of my trip. Evgeniy is very patient and detailed. I'm happy with my little piece of heart.
author: anuo136

title: Relaxing and fun!
text: Really intimate and fun. I learned some cool techniques. The teacher was a really nice guy that was easy-going and nice. Great for non-artist like me!
author: Ryan_A

title: Great memorable learning experience
text: We had a great experience.  Our three kids (7-12 yrs) enjoyed the learning experience and had a nice sketch to remember their experiences in Spain.  Evgeniy’s guidance was helpful and led them to creating a memorable piece of art for each of them.  Would highly recommend.
author: Phil_C

title: Fun sketching workshop with helpful and knowledgeable guide
text: From the meeting spot, we took a short walk to the Arc de Triomf. All the required materials were provided for us, and the step-by-step instructions were helpful and well-received; we were very happy with our end results! Would recommend for beginners and advanced artists alike!
author: Benjamin_B

title: Enriching experience!!
text: This was such a fun experience! Evgeniy was such a wondeful instructor! Super patient and taught me so much about sketching. He’s amazing. 100% recommend!
author: Andrea_M

title: Highly recommend this!
text: This was a great way to spend a morning, I was amazed that for my first architectural sketch that this turned out as well as it did!  Turned out to be a wonderful souvenir and I may even frame it!  Evgeniy was a wonderful instructor and even took the time to give some info about the history of the Gothic Quarter after the class was done, pointing out some landmarks as we walked back to the metro station.  Highly recommend this as a great activity.
author: Deb_G
